feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 28 November 2026 8:35am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 28 November 2026 at 8:35am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure south of Iceland tracking north, bringing a frontal zone across the Irish Sea today.


##Wind##

Southeast 5 to 7, veering west or southwest 4 to 6 late afternoon. Backing south or southwest tonight, then increasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough in the northeast for a time in the afternoon. Building moderate or rough tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Rain to the south soon becoming widespread, before clearing to isolated showers by the evening.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 to 7, veering west or southwest 5 or 6 Sunday afternoon, then increasing south-southwest 6 to gale 8 later on Sunday night.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough on Sunday morning. Then becoming rough later on Sunday night.


##Weather##

Showers for a time Sunday morning, then rain later on Sunday night.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
